newsitem.title: USA: Aura knows no reason for stock activity.
newsitem.headline: Aura knows no reason for stock activity.

text.p: Aura Systems Inc said Monday it was unaware of any reason for the changes in its stock price or the high trading volume in the last two weeks.
The company said it reported two consecutive profitable quarters and expects to continue to be profitable for the year.
In addition, in the last eight months it has experienced a series of positive fundamental developments that help position it for future growth and profits, it said.
Aura announced that it plans to register an initial public offering for its wholly owned subsidiary Newcom Inc. It said its legal and accounting departments are preparing the filing.

Newcom and Computone announced development of a new ISDN modem that performs at 921.6kkps, eight times faster than any current ISDN communications. The company said the product will be introduced at COMDEX November 18-22.
